gloss: to be thorough; to be attentive; to reach everywhere

definitions.gloss: to be thorough; to be attentive; to be well looked after
definitions.explanation: Said of care, attention, or management that extends to every corner of something. Most often used in the ている form to describe a place, service, or piece of work as impeccably tended.

examples.japanese: ⟦{掃除|そうじ}→掃除：02889_souji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{行|い}き{届|とど}いて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The cleaning has been done thoroughly.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{旅館|りょかん}→旅館：01049_ryokan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦サービス→サービス：01531_saabisu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{行|い}き{届|とど}いて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The service at this inn is attentive in every detail.
It feels good to look at a well-tended garden.

examples.japanese: ⟦{生徒|せいと}→生徒：01051_seito⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{数|かず}→数：00204_kazu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{多|おお}すぎて、{一人|ひとり}ひとり⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{指導|しどう}→指導：03190_shidou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{行|い}き{届|とど}かない。
examples.english: There are too many students, so instruction cannot reach every one of them.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧ (to go) + ⟦{届|とど}く→届く：00899_todoku⟧ (to reach). The subject is the care or attention itself, marked with が, not the person providing it.

ASPECT (ている):
The plain form is rare in the present tense. The normal affirmative use is {行|い}き{届|とど}いて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ (is thorough, is well looked after), a resulting state, while the negative {行|い}き{届|とど}かない points out where care is falling short.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{掃除|そうじ}→掃除：02889_souji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{行|い}き{届|とど}いて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧: is spotlessly clean
- ⟦サービス→サービス：01531_saabisu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{行|い}き{届|とど}いて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧: the service is attentive
- ⟦{手入|てい}れ→手入れ：07178_teire⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{行|い}き{届|とど}いた: well-tended (as a modifier)
- ⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{行|い}き{届|とど}く: to keep an eye on everything

TRANSITIVITY:
Intransitive. It takes no direct object; the area covered is marked with ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (すみずみ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{行|い}き{届|とど}く, to reach every corner).
